# Implementation Plan: Mode Logic Dedup

**Branch**: `001-mode-logic-dedup` | **Date**: 2026-07-26 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-mode-logic-dedup/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan is generated by `/speckit-plan`.

---

## Summary

Deduplicate the shared minimum-off-time and safety-gate logic between MANUAL and COUNTDOWN modes in the firmware code and operational rules document, without changing the `pumpMode` enum. Also, convert `checkOverflowProtection()` and `checkDryRunProtection()` to return a decision status rather than executing a hardware action (`setPump(false)`) directly.

---

## Constitution Gate *(must pass before Phase 0)*

| Principle | Status | Evidence |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| I. Fail Toward Pump OFF | ☑ Pass | The execution logic in `executePumpLogic` defaults to `setPump(false)` when `SafetyDecision::STOP_DRYRUN` or `STOP_OVERFLOW` is returned. |
| II. Dry-Run Lockout | ☑ Pass | Returning a decision preserves the lockout requirement; the main loop enforces it. |
| III. Overflow Protection | ☑ Pass | Consolidates overflow checking without removing the protection. |
| IV. TOR Independence | ☑ Pass | Hardware logic is untouched. |
| V. Sensor Freshness / E-Stop | ☑ Pass | Freshness checks are deduplicated and centralized. E-stop checks remain untouched. |
| VI. Backward Compatibility | ☑ Pass | `pumpMode` enums are unchanged. |
